utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the sixth. Are we all on? I can hear somebody's radio through Teams.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Might be mine. Sorry. Did anyone see the football last night? Absolute nonsense, that last decision.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I switched it off. Blood pressure's high enough coming in here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You should've tried the traffic on the ring road. Twenty minutes looking at the same bumper.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: You sound remarkably cheerful about it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Oh, lovely start. Then someone's new car in the car park taking up about a space and a half. Who's got the shiny blue one?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not me. Mine's the one held together by road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Structural road dirt. Don't wash it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the motoring channel. What's already cleared from last night?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the line 3 chiller last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. That was the one confusing the handover list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I tested the line 2 yesterday and it's all fine now. Finished item, not another test for today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. That one's closed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Also finished the repair on the outfeed conveyor last night. All three of those are completed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Completed work, nothing new against any of those.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: One observation, though. Heard a slight rattle from the line three, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, just an observation. Not a repair being handed out.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me. Saw the pressure on the 11kV Switchboard dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Pressure on the 11kV Switchboard? That's the wording you've got?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that's how it was described. I'm not calling it a diagnosed fault. It recovered on its own; just reporting what I saw, no action proposed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Keep that separate from the agreed jobs, then.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And we're still waiting on parts for the dryer, nothing we can do until they arrive. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Compressed Air Dryer either.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So no change there, basically.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No change. Nothing we can progress on that today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One other bit of housekeeping: we were going to replace the belt on the big boiler but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, off today's list. Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Actual work, then. We've got the risk assessment for work on the Waste Heat Boiler outstanding.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Waste Heat Boiler today. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, absolutely. That's the production hold, so first means first on that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Agreed. I'll do that before the other bits we've got here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha Begum. Today, and first because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's the distinction I wanted clear. The assessment is the outstanding bit, not a fresh maintenance job.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly, yeah. Not widening it into anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the shift handover report going round—where are we with that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, not this morning? Sorry, you clipped a bit there.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, yeah. I'll send it then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got it, Aisha Begum. Separate from today's assessment.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team this afternoon. No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Grace. This afternoon, but no rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll organise it this afternoon. It's not something that needs jumping ahead of the production hold.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: As long as the talk isn't a replay of last night's refereeing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Could do a whole session on poor decisions, couldn't we?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Anyway—sorry, talking over you. I'll run the monthly fire alarm test at half two. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Priya. Monthly fire alarm test at half two, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do it then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Half two this afternoon, yeah? Not an alarm we're expecting this morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct, half two this afternoon is the test.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll order spare parts for the Fire Alarm Panel by Wednesday. Normal priority on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Priya Raman. Spare parts for the Fire Alarm Panel by Wednesday, normal priority. Separate entry from the test.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll get the order in by Wednesday. Normal priority, no escalation.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's ordering spares, then, not saying there's another panel repair today?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Just the spare-parts order. No extra repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And mine: I'll do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor next week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, Saz, that's you with the contractor at Kestrel in Leeds next week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that. Next week, not part of today's floor work.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Enjoy the roads. Apparently we've got enough traffic for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can't wait. Right, that's the agreed list, unless someone's heard something differently.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, clear from production. The Waste Heat Boiler risk assessment today is the one that needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I've got that first. Handover report tomorrow at 9:30, so those aren't competing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the dryer stays blocked. Haven't quietly acquired a job on that while we've been talking.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same here. Completed repairs stay completed; the rattle was only an observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Nothing else added. Thanks, everyone.
